exposure: Dilation and curettage after the last CS
outcome: Risk factors for type II/III cesarean scar pregnancy
Reproductive outcomes (subsequent pregnancy, uterine rupture, recurrence of cesarean scar pregnancy)
cohort: 439 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy who received hysteroscopic treatment
finding: Multiple parity, prior cesarean section, and dilation and curettage after the last CS were associated with an increased risk of type II/III cesarean scar pregnancy.
